name: Article 5, § 1, after point b – 137
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 6. rescEU capacities shall be hosted by the Member States or the Commission. The Commission and the Member States shall, where appropriate, ensure an adequate geographical distribution of rescEU capacities. In determining the geographical distribution of rescEU capacities, the Commission shall ensure equitable access for all regions of the Union, taking into account regional disparities in existing national capacities and the particular exposure of certain regions to specific disaster risks. The Commission shall ensure that their geographical positioning is regularly assessed and adapted, taking into account accessibility constraints, territorial vulnerabilities and the specific needs of the least favoured territories.
